content: MK cites a line by Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's disciple Kātibī Turshīzī (MS Majlis 7776 f. 31a) that contrasts outward learning of the madrasa with inward knowledge by the usage of the khanaqah, as evidence that the madrasa/khanaqah pairing had already become a trope.
refers_to_primary: Kātibī Turshīzī, verse, MS Majlis 7776 f. 31a
